attributes.name: Inquirers
attributes.descriptor: We nurture our curiosity, developing skills for inquiry and research. We know how to learn independently and with others.

attributes.name: Knowledgeable
attributes.descriptor: We develop and use conceptual understanding, exploring knowledge across a range of disciplines. We engage with issues and ideas that have local and global significance.

attributes.name: Thinkers
attributes.descriptor: We use critical and creative thinking skills to analyse and take responsible action on complex problems. We exercise initiative in making reasoned, ethical decisions.

attributes.name: Communicators
attributes.descriptor: We express ourselves confidently and creatively in more than one language and in many ways. We collaborate effectively, listening carefully to the perspectives of other individuals and groups.

attributes.name: Principled
attributes.descriptor: We act with integrity and honesty, with a strong sense of fairness and justice, and with respect for the dignity and rights of people everywhere. We take responsibility for our actions and their consequences.

attributes.name: Open-minded
attributes.descriptor: We critically appreciate our own cultures and personal histories, as well as the values and traditions of others. We seek and evaluate a range of points of view, and we are willing to grow from the experience.

attributes.name: Caring
attributes.descriptor: We show empathy, compassion and respect. We have a commitment to service, and we act to make a positive difference in the lives of others and in the world around us.

attributes.name: Risk-takers
attributes.descriptor: We approach uncertainty with forethought and determination; we work independently and cooperatively to explore new ideas and innovative strategies. We are resourceful and resilient in the face of challenges and change.

attributes.name: Balanced
attributes.descriptor: We understand the importance of balancing different aspects of our lives - intellectual, physical, and emotional - to achieve well-being for ourselves and others. We recognize our interdependence with other people and with the world in which we live.

attributes.name: Reflective
attributes.descriptor: We thoughtfully consider the world and our own ideas and experience. We work to understand our strengths and weaknesses in order to support our learning and personal development.
